paragraphs.zh: 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.notes: Orphan line at the very top of the page. No [00NN] marker is printed above it; it is the tail of the paragraph that ends on the previous page. The marker [0013] is INFERRED only from the fact that the next printed marker is [0014] - it is not visible on this page. TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE: the CNIPA typesetting inserts variable justification whitespace around Latin/digit runs (the line is printed as '2- 氯 -3- 甲基 -4- 甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 ；'). That whitespace is a justification artifact carrying no information and has NOT been reproduced in the zh fields. Nothing else has been normalised. Punctuation width caveat: the scan renders CJK commas compressed, so half-width ',' cannot be reliably distinguished from full-width '，'; prose commas/periods/semicolons are transcribed as full-width per Chinese publication convention, and commas inside Latin-script locant strings ('2,2,2-', '1,2-', 'N,N-') as half-width. Downstream passes must NOT rely on punctuation width from this page.

paragraphs.zh: 5)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step-number parenthesis is printed as a narrow half-width ')' here, unlike [0020] which uses a wide full-width '）'. Recorded as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入适量的过氧苯甲酸，在回流的条件下，滴加溴素，滴完后继续反应1-10h，冷却，水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, an appropriate amount of peroxybenzoic acid is added, bromine is added dropwise under reflux conditions, and after the addition is complete the reaction is continued for 1-10 h, cooled, washed with water and concentrated to give methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 过氧苯甲酸 is verified character-by-character at high magnification and reads literally as peroxybenzoic (perbenzoic) acid, NOT 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide / BPO). Translated literally as printed. This is chemically notable - BPO is the conventional radical initiator for a benzylic bromination of this type - but nothing on the page supports substituting it, so it is left as printed and flagged in discrepancies. 溴素 = elemental bromine (Br2). No radical initiator other than the peroxy compound and no light source is mentioned.

paragraphs.zh: 6)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: The parentheses are ASYMMETRIC as printed: a narrow half-width '(' opens and a wide full-width '）' closes. Verified at high magnification. Reproduced as printed throughout the page wherever '(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）' occurs. The heading names the step-6 product as the free ACID (苯甲酸), which matches the end of [0017] but not [0017]'s intermediate - see discrepancies.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠，在室温下搅拌，然后水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯，将残余物溶于溶剂中，加入氢氧化钠水溶液，回流反应1-4h，冷却，加入稀盐酸酸化，溶剂萃取，水洗干燥浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide is added, the mixture is stirred at room temperature, then washed with water and concentrated to give ETHYL 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; the residue is dissolved in a solvent, aqueous sodium hydroxide solution is added, the mixture is refluxed for 1-4 h, cooled, acidified by addition of dilute hydrochloric acid, extracted with solvent, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: IMPORTANT: the substitution product is printed as 苯甲酸乙酯 (ETHYL ester). Verified at high magnification - the character is 乙, not 甲. The substrate entering this step is the 甲酯 (METHYL ester) and step 6) as titled in [0016] involves no transesterification, so 乙酯 is internally inconsistent and is almost certainly a typo for 甲酯. Transcribed and translated verbatim as printed per the no-typo-fixing rule; flagged in discrepancies. 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠 = sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide (the sodium alkoxide of trifluoroethanol), the same reagent that [0025] abbreviates to 三氟乙醇钠.

paragraphs.zh: 7)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Chinese ester word order is 'ACID + ALCOHOL-part + 酯', i.e. '...苯甲酸' + '3-氧代-1-环己烯' + '酯'. Rendered in English in the conventional ester order (alcohol part first). The enol ester of cyclohexane-1,3-dione is what '3-氧代-1-环己烯酯' denotes; the '1-' attachment point and '3-氧代' are read directly from the printed name, not inferred.

paragraphs.zh: 在反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺和溶剂，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜，升温回流搅拌，蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷，冷却后，加入环己二酮和碱的混合物，室温搅拌，反应物水洗，干燥，浓缩得油状物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯；
paragraphs.en: 2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, N,N-dimethylformamide and a solvent are charged into a reaction flask; at room temperature thionyl chloride is added dropwise, the temperature is raised and the mixture is stirred at reflux, the solvent is distilled off, dichloromethane is added to the residue, and after cooling a mixture of cyclohexanedione and a base is added and stirred at room temperature; the reaction mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to give, as an oil, 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 环己二酮 is printed WITHOUT a locant prefix - the text says only 'cyclohexanedione', not '1,3-环己二酮'. The 1,3-isomer is what the product name '3-氧代-1-环己烯酯' implies, but the isomer is NOT stated in this paragraph and has not been inferred. Same omission in [0026]. N,N-二甲基甲酰胺 (DMF) is used here in catalytic role alongside 氯化亚砜 (thionyl chloride) for acid chloride formation, but the paragraph does not label it a catalyst - it lists it as a charged component. 碱 (base) is unspecified here; [0026]-[0028] define the permitted inorganic and organic bases.

环磺草酮 is a Chinese common name. Verified at high magnification; the parenthesis here is a WIDE full-width '）', unlike the narrow ')' used in [0014]/[0016]/[0018]. 环磺草酮 corresponds to tembotrione, which is consistent with the benzoyl fragment built by steps 1)-7) on this page (2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl + cyclohexane-1,3-dione), but no structure is drawn on this page, so the identification rests on the name and the assembled fragments, not on a drawing.

paragraphs.zh: 在装有干燥管的反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯、氰基丙酮和三乙胺溶于溶剂中在室温持续搅拌，蒸除溶剂，萃取，水洗，干燥，浓缩得米黄色固体环磺草酮。
paragraphs.en: Into a reaction flask fitted with a drying tube are charged 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, cyanoacetone and triethylamine, dissolved in a solvent and stirred continuously at room temperature; the solvent is distilled off, the mixture is extracted, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid.
paragraphs.notes: 氰基丙酮 verified character-by-character at high magnification: it reads CYANOACETONE, not 丙酮氰醇 (acetone cyanohydrin). Translated literally as printed; flagged in discrepancies because acetone cyanohydrin is the reagent conventionally used as the cyanide source catalysing this Fries-type enol-ester rearrangement. The Chinese grammar is itself irregular - 加入 (are charged) and 溶于溶剂中 (dissolved in a solvent) are stacked without a connective, and there is no comma before 溶于 - so the English keeps the same loose construction rather than resolving it. 米黄色 rendered literally as 'rice-yellow', i.e. beige/cream. No yield, no temperature figure and no reaction time are given anywhere in this paragraph.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，步骤1)中2-氯甲苯，催化剂无水三氯化铝和甲磺酰氯的摩尔配比为1:1-3:1-2，所述溶剂为二氯甲烷、氯仿或1,2-二氯乙烷。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, in step 1) the molar ratio of 2-chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride, and methanesulfonyl chloride is 1:1-3:1-2, and said solvent is dichloromethane, chloroform or 1,2-dichloroethane.
paragraphs.notes: Ratio verified at high magnification as 1:1-3:1-2 (three components, each a range or a single value): 2-chlorotoluene 1, AlCl3 1-3, MsCl 1-2. Step 1) itself is described on the previous page and is not restated here.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，步骤2)中2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和乙酰氯的摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-2，所述溶剂为二氯甲烷、氯仿或1,2-二氯乙烷。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, in step 2) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and acetyl chloride is 1:1-5:1-2, and said solvent is dichloromethane, chloroform or 1,2-dichloroethane.
paragraphs.notes: Ratio verified as 1:1-5:1-2. The step-1 product is named here with toluene numbering (2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯), i.e. chlorine and methylsulfonyl flanking the methyl group; step 2) is a Friedel-Crafts acetylation with acetyl chloride.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，步骤5)中2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯与溴素反应的摩尔配比为1:1-1.5，所述的溶剂为四氯化碳，氯仿，二氯甲烷或1,2-二氯乙烷。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, in step 5) the molar ratio for the reaction of methyl 2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-methylbenzoate with bromine is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is carbon tetrachloride, chloroform, dichloromethane or 1,2-dichloroethane.
paragraphs.notes: The step-5 substrate is named here in a DIFFERENT locant order (2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯) from [0014]/[0015] (2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯). Both names describe the same 2-Cl / 3-CH3 / 4-SO2CH3 substitution pattern, so this is a naming-order variation and not a structural conflict; recorded in discrepancies for completeness. Note this paragraph separates the solvent list with commas (，) whereas [0022]/[0023] use the enumeration mark (、); reproduced as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，步骤6)中2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯与三氟乙醇钠的摩尔配比为1:1-1.5，所述的溶剂为四氢呋喃，乙腈，二氯甲烷或甲苯。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, in step 6) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate to sodium trifluoroethoxide is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is tetrahydrofuran, acetonitrile, dichloromethane or toluene.
paragraphs.notes: 三氟乙醇钠 here is the abbreviated form of 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠 as written in [0017]; the '2,2,2-' prefix is absent as printed and has not been added. The solvent list here (THF, MeCN, DCM, toluene) differs entirely from the [0024] list for step 5).

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，步骤7)中2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、氯化亚砜和环己二酮的摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-3，所述碱为无机碱或有机碱。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, in step 7) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, thionyl chloride and cyclohexanedione is 1:1-5:1-3, and said base is an inorganic base or an organic base.
paragraphs.notes: Ratio verified as 1:1-5:1-3. 环己二酮 again printed with no locant prefix - see the note on [0019]. This paragraph gives no molar loading for the base itself, only its identity class.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，所述的无机碱为碳酸钠，碳酸钾，氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾.
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, said inorganic base is sodium carbonate, potassium carbonate, sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide.
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph terminates with a narrow, baseline-level Western full stop '.' preceded by a space, not the full-width '。' used everywhere else on the page (compare [0028] on the very next line). Verified at high magnification and reproduced as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 按上述方案，所述的有机碱为吡啶或三乙胺。
paragraphs.en: According to the above scheme, said organic base is pyridine or triethylamine.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明所涉及的反应方程式如下：
paragraphs.en: The reaction equations involved in the present invention are as follows:
paragraphs.notes: This sentence explicitly announces the scheme that follows as THE INVENTION'S OWN route (本发明所涉及的 = 'involved in the present invention'), not prior art. The scheme itself is NOT on this page - see [0030]. Downstream passes reading the scheme on the following page should carry this attribution forward.

The marker [0030] is printed at the left margin with NO text and NO drawing after it. It is the last mark of any kind in the body; the remaining lower ~35% of the page is blank apart from the footer page number '5'. [0030] is the slot for the reaction scheme announced by [0029], which begins on the following page (p06). This is not damage or an illegible region - the page genuinely ends here.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text (there are NO drawings on this page). The step-6 substitution product is named as the ethyl ester although the substrate is the methyl ester and no transesterification is described.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page; both statements below are prose
discrepancies.text_says: [0017] reads '将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中…浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯' - substrate 甲酯 (methyl), product 乙酯 (ethyl). Character verified at high magnification as 乙. Almost certainly a printing typo for 甲酯, but transcribed verbatim. The final product of [0017] and the [0016] heading are both the free acid, so the ester identity does not change the route outcome.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The radical bromination initiator is named as perbenzoic acid rather than the benzoyl peroxide conventionally used.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0015] reads '加入适量的过氧苯甲酸' = peroxybenzoic (perbenzoic) acid. Verified character-by-character; it is NOT 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide). Recorded as printed; a downstream chemistry pass should treat the initiator identity as flagged rather than settled.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The cyclisation reagent in the final step is named cyanoacetone, where the standard reagent for this enol-ester Fries rearrangement is acetone cyanohydrin.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0021] reads '氰基丙酮和三乙胺' = cyanoacetone and triethylamine. Verified character-by-character; it is NOT 丙酮氰醇 (acetone cyanohydrin). Recorded as printed and flagged, not corrected.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The same step-5 substrate is named with two different locant orderings in two places.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0014]/[0015] say '2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯'; [0024] says '2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯'. Same 2-Cl / 3-CH3 / 4-SO2CH3 pattern, so this is a naming-order variation only, not a structural conflict.

discrepancies.what: Text omission. The diketone coupling partner is named without a locant in both places it appears.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0019] and [0026] both say only '环己二酮' (cyclohexanedione), never '1,3-环己二酮'. The 1,3-isomer is implied by the product name '3-氧代-1-环己烯酯' but is nowhere stated; the isomer has NOT been inferred into the transcription.

discrepancies.what: Printing inconsistency in punctuation that downstream passes should not read as meaningful.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: Step numbers use a narrow half-width ')' in [0014]/[0016]/[0018]/[0022]-[0026] but a wide full-width '）' in [0020]. The trifluoroethoxy parentheses are asymmetric throughout: narrow '(' opening, wide '）' closing. [0027] ends with a Western '.' where every other paragraph ends with '。'. All reproduced as printed.
